Interpolate a palette to N colors (delegated to koloRo)

Source: R/utils.R
palette_ramp.Rd

Returns a character vector of n hexadecimal colors interpolated from the named palette. When koloRo is installed the call is forwarded to koloRo::palette_ramp(); otherwise only "okabe_ito" is supported via a local colorRampPalette fallback.

Usage

palette_ramp(palette_name, n = 100, reverse = FALSE)

Arguments

palette_name

Character. Palette name from the koloRo catalogue.

n

Integer. Number of colors to generate. Default 100.

reverse

Logical. If TRUE, reverse the palette order before interpolation. Default FALSE.

Value

A character vector of n hexadecimal color codes.

References

Almaraz, P. (2026). koloRo: a comprehensive color palette collection for R. https://github.com/robustecologies/koloRo.

See also

palettes for the underlying palette catalogue.

Examples

# Built-in fallback (works without koloRo)
palette_ramp("okabe_ito", n = 5)
#> [1] "#E69F00" "#15A390" "#77AB7A" "#D26429" "#000000"
palette_ramp("okabe_ito", n = 5, reverse = TRUE)
#> [1] "#000000" "#D26429" "#78AB79" "#15A390" "#E69F00"

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Full catalogue (requires koloRo)
palette_ramp("viridis", n = 50)
} # }
